main_measure.name: mean timing gain on bars in a position (position x (next-day return - coin mean daily return))
main_measure.threshold: t >= 2 to confirm (with supporting check), t <= -2 to reject, over at least 300 bars in a position

supporting_check.name: top third minus bottom third by forecast of next-day return minus coin mean, Welch t > 0

decided_by: The mean timing gain has t >= 2 over at least 300 bars in a position and the top third beats the bottom third with Welch t > 0.
reading: Bars in a position are bars with a non-zero postRebalance_current_allocation and a next close in the same window; the thirds are cut by forecast pooled over all coins and windows (stable sort, equal-size split); the situation check uses close below the prior close within the window with forecast > 0, leaving out each window's first bar.
